description: Waste Management, Inc. is a holding company and all operations are conducted by its subsidiaries, and it was incorporated in Oklahoma in 1987 under the name USA Waste Services, Inc. and reincorporated as a Delaware company in 1995. In a 1998 merger, the Illinois-based waste services company formerly known as Waste Management, Inc. became a wholly-owned subsidiary of WMI and changed its name to Waste Management Holdings, Inc., while the parent holding company changed its name from USA Waste Services to Waste Management, Inc. Its principal executive offices are located at 800 Capitol Street, Suite 3000, Houston, Texas, and its commitment to customers begins with a vast waste collection network, which involves picking up and transporting waste and recyclable, construction and demolition, and organic materials from where it was generated to a transfer station, recycling facility or disposal site, with commercial and industrial collection services typically provided under three-year service agreements.
